purpose: Run a bounded execution smoke for the six plain forecasting baselines before any larger multidataset matrix.
research_question: Across ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity, and Traffic, how do DLinear, NLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, Mamba1, and Mamba2 compare under the same M-feature, horizon, seed, normalization, and optimizer contract?
evidence_boundary: Unauthorized exploratory baseline expansion only. It is a new matrix and cannot be concatenated with historical corrected, fair-screen, or high-dimensional artifacts that use another source snapshot or training contract.
claim_boundary: Report dataset-by-horizon descriptive metrics and paired seed deltas only. This plan does not establish a universal Mamba advantage, AutoCon/ACF gain, efficiency claim, or publication result.

required_before_launch: human review of the fresh provenance matrix and 216-job runtime budget
verify all four dataset fingerprints and the current source/environment snapshot
run matched parameter, prediction-only, and train-step resource smoke for every model family
freeze this JSON, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root
confirm that test metrics are withheld until the matrix and selection rules are frozen

seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use only the fresh output root. Retain source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, validation trajectory, and phase validation. Never copy historical metrics into this matrix.

phases.name: plain_baselines_multidataset_horizons_smoke
phases.purpose: Fresh, same-provenance plain baseline matrix; all six models receive the same datasets, horizons, seeds, optimizer, normalization declaration, and short validation-only budget.

comparison_contract.interpretation: Use paired seed deltas/log-ratios within each dataset and horizon. Windows and channels are not independent replicates. Mamba1 and Mamba2 remain separate model families; do not pool them as one Mamba result.
comparison_contract.historical_comparison_rule: Do not append these rows to corrected/highdim/fair historical tables. A publication matrix must rerun all intended baselines under one frozen source, data, normalization, optimizer, and test-release contract.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This validation-only expansion can identify missing baselines and dataset-dependent patterns, but cannot support a final ranking, non-inferiority, universal accuracy, or speed claim.

resource_contract.prediction_only: Same GPU, PyTorch/mamba_ssm versions, batch=8, fixed warmup and synchronized p50/p95 latency; report active/total parameters and peak allocated/reserved memory.
resource_contract.train_step: Before launch, measure forward+backward+optimizer with identical FP32/AMP, effective batch, loader workers, and synchronization for every model family; synthetic forward alone is insufficient for a speed claim.
resource_contract.capacity_note: The plain Mamba1/2 rows use the repository-compatible forecasting head and are external architecture baselines, not exact parameter-matched controls for MambaACF. A common-head control is required before claiming a causal architectural advantage.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validate-only and dry-run are the only permitted actions.
If any dataset hash, source snapshot, config hash, or phase artifact is missing or changed, stop the matrix rather than impute or copy a row.
Do not use test metrics to choose a model, normalization, horizon, or follow-up AutoCon/ACF candidate.
If a model family fails shape, memory, or train-step resource smoke, retain an explicit missing row and investigate; do not silently drop it from the denominator.
A favorable validation pattern is descriptive and must be replicated with fresh seeds and a separately reviewed confirmation plan.
